objective: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

description: Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.
Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
progress: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
completion: Well done. I regret not being there to see you smash those undead into rotting pulp!
